title: Viral Retinitis: ARN vs. PORN Masterclass
summary: A high-stakes comparison of Acute Retinal Necrosis (ARN) and Progressive Outer Retinal Necrosis (PORN), two devastating necrotizing herpetic retinopathies requiring rapid identification to prevent permanent visual loss.

sections.title: Definition & Overview
sections.content: ARN is a necrotizing retinitis typically seen in immunocompetent patients, usually caused by VZV, HSV-1, or HSV-2. PORN is a rapidly progressive, fulminant necrotizing retinitis characterized by extensive outer retinal necrosis, occurring almost exclusively in severely immunocompromised individuals (CD4+ < 50 cells/µL), primarily due to VZV.

sections.title: Clinical Features Checklist
content: Peripheral retinal whitening (necrotic patches)
Rapid confluence of lesions
Arteritis (ARN hallmark)
Granulomatous anterior uveitis
Retinal detachment (Rhegmatogenous)
Optic disc edema

sections.title: Red Flags: Emergencies
content: Rapid loss of vision in immunocompromised patient
Dense peripheral whitening with minimal vitritis (PORN suspicion)
Symptoms of retinal detachment (floaters/flashes)
High risk of bilateral involvement

sections.title: Diagnostic Workup
content: Step 1: Clinical Examination (Slit lamp & Dilated fundoscopy).
Step 2: Anterior Chamber (AC) or Vitreous Tap for PCR (HSV-1, HSV-2, VZV, CMV).
Step 3: Serology for HIV/Systemic health assessment.
Step 4: Systemic workup for underlying autoimmune conditions if indicated.
Step 5: Imaging (B-scan USG to rule out RD, OCT to track macular involvement).

content.explanation: A: Arteritis (Occlusive), R: Retinal Necrosis (Peripheral), N: Necrosis (Necrotizing Uveitis). Always check for retinal detachment!

sections.title: Treatment Protocol (ARN)
content: 1. IV Acyclovir (10mg/kg TID) for 7-10 days.
2. Followed by Oral Valacyclovir (1g TID) for 6+ weeks.
3. Consider prophylactic laser photocoagulation (barrage).
4. Topical steroids and cycloplegics for anterior inflammation.
5. Intravitreal Foscarnet if resistant.

sections.title: Key Clinical Pearls
content: PORN is not an inflammatory disease; the lack of vitritis makes the clear view deceptive.
The vitreous tap in PORN is essential for rapid diagnosis as serology is often useless.
Prophylactic laser barrage in ARN does not guarantee against RD due to vitreous base contraction.
Always treat the fellow eye with antivirals in ARN cases, as bilateral conversion is a high risk.
